text: The male doctor named Songwan spoke rudely. He didn't give much information when asked. The braces fell off frequently during the first period even though I was careful about what I ate. My friends who had braces done here also had them fall off. The doctor said he used good quality glue. Haha. Another friend had them done at another clinic and they didn't fall off at all. Actually, if the doctor spoke better, I would have been able to accept it in other matters. But this doctor spoke rudely every time I saw him. It was so uncomfortable that I could only do it for half a year. I immediately changed. If you're going to do it here and don't mind listening to this doctor complain and scold customers, then do it.
